The '''1951–52 Danish 1st Division''' season was the 7th edition of [[Danish 1st Division]] annual [[Association football|football]] competition in Denmark. It was contested by 10 teams.

[[Akademisk Boldklub]] successfully defended its 1952 title.

Statistics of [[Danish 1st Division]] in the 1951/1952 season.
